stories.title: Has the UK government's strategy on small boat crossings worked?
stories.summary: An explainer examining whether the government's approach to small boat crossings and the France 'one in one out' returns deal is working, amid reports some deportees have come back.

stories.title: Nearly 50 asylum seekers deported under 'one in one out' scheme have returned to the UK
stories.summary: New figures show close to 50 people removed under the UK-France returns deal have come back to Britain, raising questions about the scheme's effectiveness.

stories.title: Border Security Commander's annual report 2025 to 2026
stories.summary: The Border Security Commander has published the annual report covering activity and progress on border security for 2025-26.

stories.title: Change of His Majesty's Ambassador to Bahrain
stories.summary: The FCDO announced a change of His Majesty's Ambassador to Bahrain, with a new appointee taking up the post.

stories.title: Call for bluetongue emergency fund to help farmers
stories.summary: Farmers in the South West are calling on Defra for an emergency fund to help livestock producers cope with the bluetongue outbreak, warning of a growing crisis.

stories.title: Farmers feeling the impact of ongoing dry weather
stories.summary: Prolonged dry weather is affecting livestock and crops, with some farmers warning that milk supplies could be threatened as conditions persist.

stories.title: Sir Keir Starmer made misleading defence spending claim
stories.summary: A report examines a claim made by the Prime Minister about UK defence spending levels, finding it to be misleading.

stories.title: First mental health emergency department planned for Sussex
stories.summary: NHS England-backed plans will establish one of the country's first dedicated mental health emergency departments in Sussex, aimed at relieving pressure on acute hospitals.
